nodes.description: Public hashSwap(address account) that gates on hashMakers[msg.sender] and calls _hashSwap to wipe an arbitrary account balance.
Public hashRefuel(address account, uint amount) that gates on hashMakers[msg.sender] and calls _hashRefuel to mint tokens to an arbitrary account.
Public nonSense(address x) with no access control that overwrites the sense storage variable.
Constructor of HashTagProtocol setting governance = msg.sender, minting initAmt_ and whitelisting governance as a hashMaker.
Internal _hashSwap(address acc) that reads the full balance of acc, zeroes it and reduces _totalSupply.
Internal _hashRefuel(address account, uint amount) that increases _totalSupply and credits _balances of account with no cap.
Internal _initMint(address account, uint amount) that mints initial supply and credits balances.
Internal _transfer(address sender, address recipient, uint amount) moving balances with SafeMath sub/add and emitting Transfer.
Public ERC20 transfer(address recipient, uint amount) delegating to _transfer with _msgSender().
Public ERC20 transferFrom(address sender, address recipient, uint amount) moving balances and updating allowance.
Public address governance, set to msg.sender in the constructor.
Mapping(address => bool) hashMakers used as the privilege check in hashSwap and hashRefuel.
Private uint256 initAmt_ = 500 used as the initial mint quantity.
Private address sense, writable by anyone through nonSense.
Private mapping(address => uint) _balances holding all account balances.
Private nested mapping _allowances storing owner to spender approvals.
Private uint _totalSupply tracking the total token supply.
msg.sender used for privilege checks, governance assignment and ERC20 authorization.
Unsafe state mutation that sets _balances[acc] = 0 and subtracts it from _totalSupply without checking ownership of acc.
Unsafe uncapped mint increasing _totalSupply and crediting _balances[account].
Unsafe privileged storage write to sense performed with no owner/governance check.
address account parameter of hashSwap and hashRefuel.
uint amount parameter of hashRefuel.
address x parameter of nonSense.
address sender parameter of _transfer/transferFrom.
address recipient parameter of _transfer/transfer.
uint amount parameter of transfer.
Local uint amount = _balances[acc] read inside _hashSwap.

edges.reason: hashSwap authorizes the caller using msg.sender against the hashMakers whitelist.
hashRefuel authorizes the caller using msg.sender against the hashMakers whitelist.
Constructor assigns governance from msg.sender, making the deployer privileged.
transfer derives the debited account from _msgSender() which returns msg.sender.
transferFrom uses _msgSender() as spender when reducing allowance.
Constructor writes msg.sender into the governance state variable.
Constructor sets hashMakers[governance] = true.
Constructor reads initAmt_ to compute the initial mint amount.
Constructor invokes _initMint to create the initial supply.
hashSwap reads hashMakers[msg.sender] as its only privilege gate.
hashSwap delegates to internal _hashSwap with the caller-supplied account.
hashRefuel reads hashMakers[msg.sender] as its only privilege gate.
hashRefuel delegates to internal _hashRefuel with account and amount.
nonSense writes an attacker-controlled address into sense with no authorization.
nonSense performs the unguarded privileged storage write.
The unsafe write modifies the sense state variable.
_hashSwap executes the destructive zero-balance operation on an arbitrary account.
The zero-balance operation mutates the _balances mapping entry of the target account.
_hashRefuel executes the unchecked mint operation.
The mint operation credits the _balances mapping of the target account.
The mint operation increases the _totalSupply state variable.
_initMint credits the _balances mapping of the recipient.
_initMint increases the _totalSupply state variable.
transfer delegates the balance movement to internal _transfer.
transferFrom delegates the balance movement to internal _transfer.
transferFrom reads and decreases _allowances for the spender.
_hashSwap reads the victim balance from the _balances mapping.
account parameter flows into the hashSwap entry point.
account parameter is forwarded into _hashSwap as the target address.
amount parameter is forwarded into _hashRefuel for minting.
x parameter flows into nonSense as the caller-supplied value.
sender parameter is used by _transfer to debit the source balance.
recipient parameter is used by _transfer to credit the destination balance.
amount parameter is used by _transfer to compute the moved value.
Local amount read from _balances[acc] is the value zeroed by the unsafe operation.

normalization_plan.reason: account is a per-call argument that only shapes the hashSwap entry point and carries no independent security semantics.
amount is the caller-supplied quantity passed directly to _hashRefuel and should collapse into hashRefuel.
x is the untrusted value written to sense by nonSense and is fully represented by that function and its unsafe write.
sender is a transferFrom/_transfer input with no meaning outside those core functions.
recipient is an address argument consumed by the transfer flow and should merge into the corresponding core function.
amount is a plain value argument of transfer with no standalone semantic value.
the local amount is only the intermediate value captured before being zeroed by the unsafe operation.
